purpose: Keycloak 26.4.0 platform IdP image bundled with the MaintAI custom login theme and pre-built Quarkus artifacts via kc.sh build.
boundaries: Keycloak stays a platform identity runtime; application services consume only standard OIDC/JWT/JWKS contracts.
No client secrets, realm passwords, or environment-specific hostnames are baked into this image; GitOps/infrastructure supply realm config and ExternalSecrets at runtime.
